content: .{@-उच्चयः@} .²1 a large fragment of a crag or rock fallen from a mountain and forming an irregular mound. .²2 incompleteness, deficiency, defect. .²3 the middle pace of elephants; स्थूलोच्चयेनागमदन्तिकागताम् <ls>Śi. 12. 16</ls>. .²4 an eruption of pimples on the face. .²5 a hollow at the root of an elephantʼs tusks.
